deliverables: Ongoing maintenance including bug fixes, dependency upkeep, security patches, and releases
Dijkstra readiness including Plutus V4 support, ledger rules, transaction-builder updates, cost models, nested transactions, accounts, guard scripts, and conformance testing
Improved JS/TS interfaces and documentation for Scalus components embedded in MeshJS, Evolution SDK, and Lucid Evolution
Java/Kotlin integration examples and cleaner integration paths with Cardano Client Lib and Yaci
Scoped runtime components including reactive workers, chain follower, task scheduler, backend workflows, and reference validation
request.what: Funding for a 9-month continuation of Scalus covering maintenance, Dijkstra hard-fork readiness, interoperability across JVM and JS/TS ecosystems, and a scoped application runtime.

claims.claim: Scalus is an open-source Cardano development platform built by Lantr Engineering over three years of continuous delivery.
The proposal asks for ₳2,464,844 over 9 months at a $0.16/ADA reference rate with no contingency.
Scalus is used directly by Gummiworm L2, Bifrost, SugarRush, Vela, and DID/DIDComm projects.
Scalus components are reused in MeshJS SDK, Evolution SDK, Lucid Evolution, Cardano Client Lib, and YaciDevKit.
The proposer reports three years of development, 4,642 commits, 32 releases, 12 contributors, and 20,000+ monthly Scalus.js downloads.

This resubmission reduces the prior proposal from ₳8.503M over 12 months to about ₳2.465M over 9 months and narrows scope by removing the standalone L1 node, full L2 integration, broad formal verification, and advanced devnet expansion.
The funded work is organized into three quarterly milestones from July 2026 through March 2027, with maintenance running continuously across milestones.
Delivery is described as milestone-based and administered through audited SundaeSwap treasury contracts with an independent oversight board and third-party assurance.

The proposer argues Dijkstra changes including Plutus V4, nested transactions, guard script types, and accounts require updates to Scalus smart contract development, evaluation, transaction building, ledger rules, testing, and workflows.
Lantr Engineering says it will commit to public reporting, open community sessions, and on-time milestone delivery for treasury-funded work.

summary: The document presents a reduced treasury request for Scalus maintenance, Dijkstra readiness, interoperability, and a scoped runtime, with stated ecosystem reuse and milestone-based delivery but several adoption and governance assurances remaining proposer-asserted within the anchor text.
